text:
Maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for Dedicated capacity (SLA + throughput + autoscale). Need final acceptance criteria and concrete autoscale rules for next week's review. Customers are pushing for tighter p99; we should list the tradeoffs and a clear runbook.

Alex: Got it. What p99 target are we debating? 99 vs 99.5 vs 99.9 will change sizing a lot.

Maria: Customer A asked for 99.5 @ 500ms for small-chat SKU. Internally I think launching with 99 @ 400ms and a paid premium for 99.5 is realistic. We need the PRD to surface cost delta and rollback policy.

Kevin: Engine note — for model-small (8k ctx) on a 4xA100 pool we see p95 ~= 120ms, p99 ~= 360ms in our lab traces. Hitting 99.5 requires pinned capacity + more conservative batching which roughly doubles infra cost for that tenancy. Recommend SLO matrix in PRD showing cost vs latency tiers.

TJ: Autoscale proposals: scale-up when GPU util > 70% AND median queue time > 500ms sustained for 60s. Add one GPU per step, max 4 steps. Scale-down: util < 40% and queue < 200ms for 10m. Cooldown 5m between scaling events. Also enforce per-customer capacity cap to avoid noisy neighbors.

Maria: Acceptance criteria I'm thinking: 
- Load test: sustained 2x expected peak with p99 <= target for 95% of runs.
- Canary: 1% traffic canary for 15m, auto rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p99 regresses > 2x baseline.
- Fallback: documented automatic fallback to cheaper model variant with degraded confidence scores.
- Monitoring: alert if inferred cost per 1M tokens > budget threshold.

Alex: Quick runbook snippet I'm adding to PRD: 
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  scale_up_condition:
    - gpu_util > 0.70
    - queue_ms_median > 500 for 60s
  scale_up_step: 1_gpu
  max_steps: 4
  scale_down_condition:
    - gpu_util < 0.40
    - queue_ms_median < 200 for 600s
  cooldown: 300s
  per_customer_cap: 2_pools
```

ops-bot: Provisioning completed: reserved pool rp-231 is healthy (instances: 4xA100).

Kevin: Edge case to include in PRD: many small concurrent requests bypass prefix cache → KV cache misses spike latency. Mitigations: prefix/KV TTL tuning, recommend client batching or token-bucket rate limit. Add a test in CI that simulates N=5000 small concurrent requests.

Maria: Good catch. Action items: Alex — run the 2x load test and upload results (due Tue). Kevin — estimate cost delta to hit 99.5 and write up the cache-miss mitigation section. TJ — draft the autoscale playbook + rollback steps. I'll update the PRD acceptance criteria and coordinate contract language with legal. Thanks all :thumbsup:
